The low-power alternative mitigates the immediate drain on life support reserves, but it shifts the burden back to Jora—the breach must be perfectly calmed before this volatile chemical can work. Ren watches the void at Node Three, anticipating how a temporary structural fix will impact its volatile informational state. The tactical priority is now clear: perfect thermal suppression before chemical application.
